study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Floris et al., Nature Mental Health, 2025
study_identification_part.si_4_title: A multimodal neural signature of face processing in autism within the fusiform gyrus

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Normative models were trained using Bayesian linear regression. A B-spline basis expansion was used to model nonlinear effects of age.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Here, we trained normative models using Bayesian linear regression 98 for each brain imaging modality... A B-spline basis expansion of the covariate vector was used to model nonlinear effects of age.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: The study modeled voxel-wise GM volumes (sMRI), seed-based correlation between FFA and FFG (rs-fMRI), T-contrast maps for faces vs shapes (task-fMRI), and the principal component of source-reconstructed activation time series (EEG).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: features for subsequent normative modeling were as follows (1) structure: voxel-based morphometry (VBM)-derived, voxel-wise GM volumes, (2) rs-fMRI: seed-based correlation between the FFA and the remaining FFG, (3) task-fMRI: T-contrast maps reflecting sensitivity to faces and (4) EEG: the principal component of source-reconstructed activation obtained across different cortical FFG parcels.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Covariates used were age, sex, and scanning site.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: using age, sex and scanning site as covariates.
